mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average 20-day return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, which may trigger central bank intervention via rate cuts, boosting equity valuations through lower discount rates and improved risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in lower future earnings.
failure_condition: When both HOUST < 850 and RSAFS < 410000, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 95.0 over the past 2 months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to deteriorating corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (measured via RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When both RSAFS > 415000 and HOUST > 850, SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50,000 over the past 3 months signals labor market stagnation, which increases the likelihood of a policy response and reduces the risk of overheating, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth is below 50,000, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 55% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over the past 3 months, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that may trigger a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth above 2.0% on a year-over-year basis, combined with rising industrial production, signals strong underlying economic momentum, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 13700 and INDPRO > 97.0, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or occur in fewer than 60% of such instances.
